cases.name: Sandra Aldridge
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative:
On 4/17/2020, deputies found her nude body with multiple gashes in her neck and hands; her left leg was missing from just above the knee.

He slit her throat and cut off her lower leg with a hacksaw after she had bled to death in their home. Cortez called 911 and said he and a woman he erroneously referred to as his wife had been stabbed and were dying, the DA's office said. Cortez then said he had stabbed her three or four times, that “her leg was gone” and that “I took it too far.”

Investigators said the smell of bleach filled the air, indicating someone had attempted to clean up the scene. A freshly dug hole was discovered in the yard with a shovel nearby, and detectives would later find Aldridge's severed leg in a plastic bag in the freezer.

An autopsy would later find Aldridge died from having her carotid artery and jugular vein severed, the DA's office said.
